test_case_name: Accept All Cookies on Mobile App Page

intents.intent: Click 'Tutti i giorni' on the parent page to access the Intesa Sanpaolo Mobile app section.
Click 'Acconsento' on the child page to accept all cookies.
And then check that the cookie banner is dismissed and cookies are accepted on the child page.

test_case_name: Access Cookie Policy Options from Mobile App Page

intents.intent: Click 'Tutti i giorni' on the parent page to access the Intesa Sanpaolo Mobile app section.

And then check that the cookie policy options or privacy settings are displayed on the child page.
